$comment: Coordinator operations of the artifacts domain; the rules are in ops.schema.json $comment and contracts/README.md.

artifact_get.description: One artifact by artifactId: its record, copies and download state

artifact_list.description: Artifacts by execution, task, project, media type, text, state or time, newest first, paged with before and limit

artifact_rule_confirm.description: Operator only. ruleHash: the preview's hash; a changed rule is 409.

artifact_rule_preview.description: Operator only. rule: a retention rule of the project settings.

artifact_upload_begin.description: An operator upload (a message attachment) into the artifact store: the project of the session when sessionId is given, else projectId (absent or null: no project). Access is the project grant. No size limit beyond store capacity.

store_set_free_space_warning.description: Operator only. bytes: a whole number; null clears the warning.

stores_list.description: Artifact stores with their free space and warning thresholds

ArtifactListReply.$comment: nextBefore: only with limit; null on the last page. counts: rows per state matching the filter without states.

excludeProjectIds.$comment: leave out rows of these projects (the app passes the person's ignored projects while the view names no project, OR-34); '-' (as in excludeProjectIds of questions_list, executions_list and delivery_status) or null (as in projectIds) is no project; applied after projectIds. Agents see every project unless they pass it.

projectId.$comment: the project whose copies go; '-' is no project (only project-less copies); omitted or null is every project

summary.$comment: One line naming what the result holds, from the summary field of a pipeline's output.json; absent otherwise.

taskCode.$comment: the task code when the row has a task

taskAttempts.$comment: Executions of the result's task so far (its attempts, controls/work-facts.md); null without a task.

harness.$comment: The harness of the run that made the result; null without a run.

variant.$comment: The Lab variant (the method short name) of the run that made the result; null outside a Lab trial.

code.$comment: the result's own D17 code (R-FLT-12), originals only; open the result by it (entity_resolve)

ArtifactRuleConfirmRequest.$comment: Operator only. ruleHash: the preview's hash; a changed rule is 409.

ArtifactRulePreviewReply.$comment: sample: up to 10 matching artifacts (id, name, size).

ArtifactRulePreviewRequest.$comment: Operator only. rule: a retention rule of the project settings.

ArtifactUploadBeginReply.$comment: url: PUT the bytes there in order, at most partBytes per request, each with Content-Range: bytes <first>-<last>/<size>; the reply to the last part is the stored ArtifactView (docs/designs/fleet-conversations.md, Attachments).

ArtifactUploadBeginRequest.$comment: An operator upload (a message attachment) into the artifact store: the project of the session when sessionId is given, else projectId (absent or null: no project). Access is the project grant. No size limit beyond store capacity.

code.$comment: the result's own D17 code (R-FLT-12), originals only; the viewer names and links the result by it

taskCode.$comment: the D17 code of the task it belongs to

ArtifactView.$comment: One artifact with its copies; availability available (with an authenticated same-origin /api/results/:id URL for people and agent tools), unavailable, or the artifact state. Host transfer reads retain presigned store URLs.

StoreSetFreeSpaceWarningRequest.$comment: Operator only. bytes: a whole number; null clears the warning.

StoresListReply.$comment: problems: full stores and placement problems the caller may see, each with its actions.
